bullets.text: In Thiruvallur district near Ponneri, a low-hanging electricity wire electrocuted a wild deer and two cows, and the office should monitor power line safety.
Heavy rains flooded major roads in Avadi and Ambattur, and the office should coordinate relief operations with local authorities.
A 10-year-old boy in Thirumazhisai, Thiruvallur district, died of dengue, and the office should ensure immediate health safety measures are intensified.

The Madras High Court ordered the Hindu Religious and Charitable Endowments Department and Chennai Corporation to respond regarding a permanent road on temple land in Velachery, and the office should track the proceedings.
An elderly couple staged a protest at the Avadi sub-registrar office alleging officials were complicit in a 25 crore land grab, and the district team should investigate.
Intruders and drunk individuals have been causing disruptions at a government school in Thiruvallur, and the office must ensure campus security.
An electricity consumers grievance meeting is scheduled in Periyakuppam, Thiruvallur, and the office should monitor public grievances addressed there.
Deputy Prime Minister Gan Kim Yong and Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay inaugurated a CapitaLand Data Centre in Chennai, and the portfolio team should track further infrastructure growth.
MeitY launched indigenous AI models including EKA-1 and Dhir under the IndiaAI Mission, and the portfolio team should review local deployment opportunities.
StartupTN Chairman Singai G. Ramachandran stated that over 50 percent of registered startups in Tamil Nadu are women-led, and the office should support inclusive startup policies.
